newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-O'NEILL TO STAY AS LEICESTER MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-O'NEILL TO STAY AS LEICESTER MANAGER.

text.p: Martin O'Neill, manager of English League Cup winners Leicester, will end speculation linking him to the vacancy at Everton on Wednesday by signing a new extension to his contract.
The former Nothern Ireland international, understood to be the lowest paid manager in the premier league, has accepted a new deal that will double his basic salary.
"Wild horses wouldn't drag me away," O'Neill said on Tuesday. "After winning the League Cup we're in Europe next season so why should I move on and hand that over to someone else."
